SPECIAL OFFER FOR INVESTORS! — COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR SALE IN LAS DELICIAS

Excellent investment opportunity in the Las Delicias neighborhood.

A 100 m² commercial space is for sale, located on Calle Conde de la Viñaza, in an excellent location with multiple possibilities.

The premises feature a large, completely open-plan space at street level, as well as a mezzanine with a spacious office, providing additional space ideal for a workspace, administration, storage, or business management.
